scope: Licensed real-object segmentation cohort source with independent published reference masks; model predictions are never used as ground truth.
mask_convention: Published masks are normalized by the collector/benchmark to uint8 grayscale: 0/black = foreground object, 255/white = background.
split_policy: Deterministic source-group split. When plant/session metadata is unavailable, group by numeric image-id hundred-bucket and assign whole groups to dev or heldout by SHA-256 modulo 5.

sources.description_evidence: Dataset description states it contains 233 high-resolution leaf images in natural environments and a mask folder with ground truth masks.
